title: Sweet Japanese Salmon Soup
description: A delicious and comforting Japanese-inspired soup featuring sweet salmon and creamy coconut milk.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the salmon fillet and sear until cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side. Set aside.
In the same pot, add diced sweet potatoes and carrots. Cook until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add soy sauce and sesame seeds. Stir to combine.
Return the cooked salmon to the pot and simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
If using Vietnamese fish sauce, add a drizzle to individual bowls.
